text: The SAC3 is a submachine gun that appears in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. Much like the XMG, the SAC3 is dual-wielded by default, but five single-wielded supply drop variants were added to the game.
The Ripped MG Turret is a weapon available in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, and briefly seen in Call of Duty: Mobile.
Riot-12 is a weapon in the prequel comic to Call of Duty: Black Ops III.

Captain Rion Jones is an antagonist in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and a member of the Settlement Defense Front. He's assigned to the SetDef warship SDS NB Quirinis. Jones is killed by Nick Reyes in a dogfight during Operation Blood Storm.
Roll the Dice is a Legendary gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It grants the player an extra random attachment to their weapon upon spawning. This attachment changes upon each new life.

The SATO APC is a vehicle featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare used by SATO. It appears in Operation Burn Water and Operation Blood Storm. The vehicle is often equipped with what appears to be an autocannon, though some variants lack this weapon.

S.O.E. is the fourth campaign level in Call of Duty: WWII. The player plays as Ronald "Red" Daniels as he participates in the assault on a German armoured train carrying V-2 Rockets, on its way to Paris. After the train is destroyed and essential credentials are found in the wreckage, Camille "Rousseau" Denis, a French resistance leader, introduces herself and announces plans for the credentials.

The Ripsaw is a buildable and upgradable geistkraft weapon that appears in the Nazi Zombies map The Darkest Shore as a buildable and The Shadowed Throne, The Tortured Path, Bodega Cervantes, U.S.S. Mount Olympus, and Altar of Blood from the Mystery Box for 1,000 Jolts.
The Roar of Sang'ket (also known as the Thulian Shield) is one of the four Thulian weapons featured in the Call of Duty: WWII Nazi Zombies map The Frozen Dawn.
The S6 Stingray is a two-round burst tactical rifle added to Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 with the Days of Summer continuation of the Operation Spectre Rising update.
The Rising Tide is a melee weapon that was added to Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 with the Days of Summer event.
The SA87 Ultralight Hollow is a stock attachment for the SA87 bullpup light machine gun in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare.
Royal Armory is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare.
The is a semi-automatic sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Mobile.

After the massive explosion aboard the Kurohana-go, the disaster’s sole survivor, Kui Ji - who served as the ship’s security director - was retrieved and medically treated by Korohana Corporation. His perceived dereliction of duty, coupled with Rin Yoshida’s tireless efforts to save him, led Kui Ji to voluntarily petition for a return to Serpent Island to personally retrieve the lost T-3. Kurohana’s willingness to spare no expense in resuscitating Kui Ji stemmed from their appreciation for such a rare asset - a man who managed to survive the extreme effects of T-3. - DMZ-Recon Character DescriptionRyotaro Nagashima, also known as Kui Ji, is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile who was added on April 22nd, 2022, during Season 3: Radical Raid as part of the So-Ken Draw. Kui Ji appears in the DMZ: Recon mode as a boss enemy found at the Kurohana Ship in Serpent Island.
The is a light machine gun featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II. The SAKIN MG38 is also available in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III as part of the Modern Warfare II content carryover.
The is a bolt-action marksman rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II. The SA-B 50 is also available in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III as part of the Modern Warfare II content carryover.
The Rover is a four wheeled ground vehicle used by both SDF and SATO forces.
Ripper Arrows are an ammunition attachment featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. It is available after getting the Bow to level 5.
The Ryden 45K is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.
The Roc 20mm is a special weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7. It was added on September 24th, 2026 as part of the Season Six update.

Sergeant Sam Rivers is an African-American soldier who led a small tank battalion from the 1st Armored Division of Patton's Third Army during World War II. Sam Rivers is only seen in the game Call of Duty: Finest Hour. He is playable in the level, Come Out Fighting.

The Tokarev SVT-40 is a Soviet semi-automatic rifle that appears in Call of Duty: United Offensive, Call of Duty 2, Call of Duty: World at War, Call of Duty: World at War (Nintendo DS), Call of Duty: WWII and Call of Duty: Vanguard.

The STG-44 (also known as the MP44), is the most common assault rifle in the Call of Duty series, having been featured in every Call of Duty title set in World War II (excluding Call of Duty: Finest Hour), as well as Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Black Ops, Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, Call of Duty: Black Ops III, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. It also makes a brief appearance in the Call of Duty: Mobile comics. It is one of the most common weapons to appear across the Call of Duty series, second only to the M1911.
The is an integrally suppressed submachine gun featured in Call of Duty Online, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.

Sergeant Sabir Volok (Russian: Сабир Волок) is a tank commander in the Red Army who commanded a T-34 and partook in Operation: Little Saturn. Volok's tank was stuck in a warehouse near the end of the level "Operation Little Saturn", with Germans on his tank, trying to get in. He radioed for assistance, soon followed by the arrival of Major Badanov's tank to shoot the Germans off the tank. Later, in Airfield Ambush, Volok told Badanov that the Germans had barricaded themselves inside the communications tower. Lt. Vidov called reinforcements to take once Badanov arrived at the scene, though he is nowhere to be seen.

:For other variants, see SCAR-L, HAMR and MR23. The is a weapon appearing as an assault rifle in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty Online, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Mobile and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered, and as a battle rifle in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.
The was the main medium machine gun used by the Soviet Union during World War II.
The is a vehicle and a killstreak reward in Call of Duty: Black Ops.

The is an assault rifle that is featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2: Force Recon, Find Makarov: Operation Kingfish, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.
Sahara Camouflage is a weapon camouflage skin featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops and Call of Duty: Black Ops II.
The SKS is a rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops (Nintendo DS), Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, and Call of Duty: Mobile.

Samaritan is a Stryker ICV which first appeared in the level Black Tuesday, equipped with a M2 Browning Machine Gun. It provides support for Delta Force soldiers operating in the Manhattan area during the Battle of New York. Unlike Firefly, it is not destroyed.
The , also referred to as the SIG556, is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops II.

The is a bullpup weapon appearing as a sniper rifle in Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Strike Team, and Call of Duty Online, and as a marksman rifle in Call of Duty: Ghosts and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It was also briefly seen in Call of Duty: Mobile.

The SMR, referred to as Saritch in the game files, is a semi-automatic (fully-automatic in the campaign), bullpup assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops II. It has the highest damage per shot of all assault rifles in multiplayer.
The SOC-T is a vehicle used in the Call of Duty: Black Ops II and makes a brief appearance in Call of Duty: Mobile.

:For other variants, see FAL, FAL OSW, XM-LAR and IA-2. The SC-2010 is an assault rifle that appears in Call of Duty: Ghosts and Call of Duty: Heroes. The weapon has low damage compared to other assault rifles, but it is compensated with very low recoil and long range.

The is a military boat seen at the end of "The Hunted" and is used to rescue Merrick, Logan T. Walker, Elias "Scarecrow" Walker and Keegan P. Russ from the Amazon jungle. It is operated by US Navy SWCCs (Special Warfare Combatant-craft Crewmen).
The SSN Utah is a Submarine appearing in Call of Duty: Strike Team.
The SN6 is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. It also makes a brief appearance in Call of Duty: Mobile.

The Satellite Drone is a melee weapon in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, Call of Duty: Black Ops III, Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and Call of Duty: Mobile. It is the objective in the game mode Uplink and Defender, and is used in a Special round on Exo Survival.

The SPBC (Special Purpose Battle Carbine) is an assault rifle featured of Call of Duty Online. Specially for use in CQB encounters.It is based on a the AR15 platform and fires a special oversize .50 caliber round converted from the .50AE used by the Desert Eagle.Semi-auto with great stopping power at clsoe range,This is the initial weapon feature of SPBC. However, due to the weapon being unpacked in advance, there was a significant change in the numerical value after its official launch.
The SVG-100 is a bolt-action sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops III and a scrapped weapon from Call of Duty: Black Ops 4.
The SDS Ares Vallis is a Settlement Defense Front carrier in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare under the command of captain Bradley Fillion.
The SWSC-1 Olympus Mons is a Settlement Defense Front supercarrier and the largest and most powerful warship in the solar system of Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare.
The SDS Hellas is a Settlement Defense Front carrier under the command of Vice Admiral Vlad Derhachov.

The SDS Iani Chaos was a Settlement Defense Front destroyer. The warship was destroyed by Nick Reyes during Operation Safe Harbor. Attila Zalanyi and Karl Drown were assigned to this destroyer and were killed in the same battle.
The SDS Cerberus is a Settlement Defense Front carrier. It carried a prototype stealth Skelter.

The SDS Argas is a Settlement Defense Front destroyer featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. The warship is destroyed by Nick Reyes during Operation Grave Robber. Sang Yup Kim and Ivan Perez were both assigned to the vessel as Skelter pilots.

SBD is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is exclusive to the Widowmaker - Smoke variant. It gives the weapon an advanced built-in suppressor that doesn't effect the weapon's normal damage range.

The SDF APC is an armored vehicle used by the Settlement Defense Front in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. They appear during Operation Port Armor and Operation Black Flag. Benjamin Last, the artist who designed the vehicle, states that it uses in-wheel motors, freeing up cabin space as this removes the needs for an axle or drive shaft. Different tires could also be used for different planetary environments, with the wheel system also acting as the suspension. In addition, the early stages of the vehicle's concept were intended to suggest it was a multi-function platform that was normally used in infrastructure construction but had been adapted for military use.
The Sarsaparilla is a broken bottle used as a melee weapon. It was added to Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered on the June 27th, 2017 update.

The SATO Marine Corps is SATO's space naval infantry to operate anywhere in the Solar System from ships to planets and moons. The Marine Corps operate from ship or base security to infantry and can be deployed from ships to moons aboard SATO Drop Ships.
The Saug 9mm (stylized SAUG) is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4. It was developed in South Africa. It also has an MKII variant along with a Mastercraft variant.
The SDK 9mm is a bolt-action bullpup sniper rifle that features an integral suppressor. It was added to Call of Duty: WWII with the Halloween Scream event.
The SDM is a semi-automatic sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4.

The SDS Cydonia is a Settlement Defense Front destroyer. The ship was under construction at the time the SWSC-1 Olympus Mons arrived under UNSA control and attacked the shipyards. It's most likely that it was destroyed. The ship appears on the map Skydock. In addition to the regular destroyer armament, Cydonia appeared to have additional R-28 Taskmaster guns, while also possessing what appeared to be a larger version of the Taskmaster on its missile bulge.
The SDS Nerio is a Settlement Defense Front destroyer. The warship was present during Operation Deep Execute where it sent Captain Oren Emin.
The SDS Pavonis Mons is a Settlement Defense Front destroyer. The warship was present during Operation Deep Execute where it sent Captain Khosi Siyada.
The SDS Crivitz is a Settlement Defense Front destroyer. The warship was present during Operation Pure Threat where it was destroyed. Hari Khalsa was assigned to the ship as a Skelter pilot.
The SDS AFB Titan Bravo is a Settlement Defense Front A-Jak. The warship was present during Operation Sudden Death where it was destroyed.

The SDS Centauri is a Settlement Defense Front carrier in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. The ship dropped off pilots to the sun and managed to avoid UNSA Forces during Operation Trace Kill. It is unknown what happened to the vessel after the events of Operation Blood Storm.
The SDS Deimos is a Settlement Defense Front destroyer. The warship is destroyed during the shipyard destruction in Operation Blood Storm.
The SDS NB Quirinis is a Settlement Defense Front destroyer featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. The warship is destroyed during the shipyard destruction in Operation Blood Storm.
The SDS Nemesis is a Settlement Defense Front destroyer. The warship was destroyed by the F-SpAr weapon during Operation Blood Storm.
The SDS Tharsis was a Settlement Defense Front destroyer. The warship was destroyed by Nick Reyes using the F-SpAr weapon on the SWSC-1 Olympus Mons during Operation Blood Storm.
The SDS Phobos was a Settlement Defense Front destroyer. The warship was destroyed by the F-SpAr weapon during Operation Blood Storm.
The SDS Valiant was a Settlement Defense Front destroyer. The warship was destroyed by the F-SpAr weapon during Operation Blood Storm.
The SDS Nereidum was a Settlement Defense Front destroyer featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. The warship was destroyed by the F-SpAr weapon during Operation Blood Storm.
The SDS Ascraeus was a Settlement Defense Front destroyer. The warship was destroyed by the F-SpAr weapon during Operation Blood Storm.
The SDS Elysium was a Settlement Defense Front destroyer. The warship was destroyed by the F-SpAr weapon during Operation Blood Storm.
The SDS Arsia was a Settlement Defense Front destroyer. The warship was destroyed by the UNSA-hijacked SWSC-1 Olympus Mons during Operation Blood Storm.
The SDS Argyre was a Settlement Defense Front destroyer. The warship was destroyed by the F-SpAr weapon during Operation Blood Storm.
The SDS Utopia was a Settlement Defense Front destroyer. The warship was destroyed by the F-SpAr weapon during Operation Blood Storm.
The SDS Anseris was a Settlement Defense Front destroyer featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. The warship was destroyed by the F-SpAr weapon during Operation Blood Storm.
The SDS Daedalia was a Settlement Defense Front destroyer. The warship was destroyed by the F-SpAr weapon during Operation Blood Storm.
The SDS Peraea was a Settlement Defense Front destroyer. The warship was destroyed by the F-SpAr weapon during Operation Blood Storm.
The SWAT RFT is an assault rifle that was added to Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 with the Operation Absolute Zero update. It has an MKII variant and a Mastercraft variant called the Temple of Boom.

The (Sport Utility Vehicle) is a vehicle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Black Ops 4, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Mobile, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.
The SDF Destroyer is a Settlement Defense Front warship featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare.
The STVOL Precision Comb is a stock attachment for the Kar98k marksman rifle in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare.
STVOL (Russian: Ствол Тактический), sometimes misspelled as "STOVL", is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.
The SDF Carrier is a Settlement Defense Front warship featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare.

:For other variants, see R700, LA-B 330 and SA-B 50. The is a bolt-action marksman rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Mobile, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.
The SKS Rifle Stock" is a Stock class attachment featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare.
The is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, Call of Duty: Mobile, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.
The is a dive bomber aircraft featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard and Call of Duty: Warzone.

The SD Instant Grat is a Barrel attachment available uniquely for the EX1 Assault Rifle in Call of Duty: Vanguard. It helps to increase the recoil control, accuracy and flinch resistance as well as the removal of the charge-up time and reduced scope sway and gun bob. However, this in cause lowers the aim down sight, movement and sprint to fire speed respectfully.

Samael is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on October 10th, 2022, during Season 8: Train to Nowhere as part of the Life and Death Draw. Later, during Season 9: Zombies Are Back, Samael was introduced in the Comics.
The is a bolt-action sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II. The SP-X 80 is also available in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III as part of the Modern Warfare II content carryover.
Sakin Arms, sometimes abbreviated as SA, is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.
The is a battle rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. It was added on March 6th, 2024 as part of the Season Two Reloaded update.
The Saug is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It was added as part of the Season One update.

The SCAR Mod 2 was an assault rifle that was featured in Call of Duty: Future Warfare. It sported a futuristic look with a sleeker design and white camouflage. However, when Future Warfare was canceled, the SCAR was discarded as well, and was never ported to any other future titles.

SG may refer to: *SG-43 Goryunov - A mounted machine gun in Call of Duty: United Offensive. *PSG1 - A sniper rifle in Call of Duty: Black Ops. *KSG 12 - A shotgun in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3. *KSG - A shotgun in Call of Duty: Black Ops II and Call of Duty: Strike Team. *CSG-12 - A shotgun in Call of Duty Online. *SG12 - A shotgun in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 and Call of Duty: Black Ops 7. *ASG-89 - The USAS 12 shotgun as it is called in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.

SV may refer to: *SVT-40 - A semi-automatic rifle in some World War II-era games. *Dragunov, also called SVD - A sniper rifle in multiple games. *SVU - A sniper rifle / marksman rifle in Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Strike Team, Call of Duty: Ghosts, Call of Duty Online, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. *SVG-100 - A sniper rifle in Call of Duty: Black Ops III. *SVA 545 - An assault rifle in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. *NSV - A heavy machine gun in Call of Duty: Mobile. *KSV - A submachine gun in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.

The Secret Wall is an easter egg in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. It is seen in the level where the player plays as Sam Rivers inside a tank. On the first time the player dismounts the tank and clears a building, there will be small farmhouse in front and to the slight left of the tank. The smaller part of the wall should have a hay bale on it. Try and jump sideways into it, and after a few tries the player will jump straight through the wall, and into a secret room. The room has a few health-packs, which are rare in this certain level, and also has a giant chair in it. But the strangest thing is a small open door in a corner that looks as if it is doll-sized and the inside of it is glowing bright green.

The Sd. Kfz. 251 was the standard German armored personnel carrier during World War II. They are a common enemy in the series, and are typically destroyed using anti-tank weaponry such as Panzerfausts or Panzerschrecks. In almost all appearances, they are shown armed with an MG42. On certain occasions, they are also shown in their capacity as troop transports.
, or Leichter Panzerspähwagen (Light Armored Reconnaissance Vehicle), was a series of light four-wheel drive armored cars. It appears in most of the Call of Duty games taking place in World War II.

Sawed-Off is a weapon attachment for the Double-Barreled Shotgun in Call of Duty: World at War and Call of Duty: Black Ops, and for other weapons in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Mobile and Call of Duty: Vanguard. It usually increases power, but decreases accuracy and range.
Private Schmitter was a soldier who was part of the 1st Infantry Division that fought under the command of Lt. Walker in Call of Duty: Finest Hour.
Fregattenkapitän Schmidt was a German officer and administrative official in the Kriegsmarine, stationed on the Battleship Tirpitz.
Setting Sun Camouflage was a weapon camouflage skin set to appear in Call of Duty: World at War, but was cut from the final version of the game.

Severed Ties is the sixteenth campaign mission of Call of Duty: Ghosts. It involves commanding an M1A2 Abrams tank in order to destroy a Federation Satellite Array, which will allow friendly astronauts to engage enemy forces in space to over take the LOKI Space Station.
Semi-automatic is an attachment in Call of Duty: Ghosts and a weapon perk in Call of Duty: Mobile, allowing players to change a weapon's fire mode to semi-automatic.
The Scale Camouflage is a weapon camouflage skin featured in Call of Duty: Ghosts. This camouflage is unlocked in various ways.

The was a four-wheel drive off-road vehicle, with amphibious capabilities, that was used prominently by the Wehrmacht and Waffen-SS. It was set to appear in Call of Duty: World at War before it was cut. It is unknown whether it was to appear in singleplayer or multiplayer, but it is known for definite that it was cut early on in development, since only a basic handling file remains.

On-site Sentinel Reinforcements is an Orbital Care Package item in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare on the Exo Zombies maps Carrier and Descent. It's recognized by its grey Sentinel logo. When picked-up, the player is able to deploy a small squad of Sentinel operatives, who will aid them in killing zombies and enemy troops.

Sekhmet's Vigor is a wonder weapon that appear in the Zombies map Origins in Call of Duty: Black Ops II and Call of Duty: Black Ops III and The Tomb in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. The weapon serves as an "attachment" for the four Elemental Staffs once they have been upgraded, taking the slot that a Grenade Launcher would normally take on an Assault Rifle. Sekhmet's Vigor is located on the bottom of the staff, causing the player to flip their staff over once selected. The weapon is able to revive downed teammates if one shoots a downed teammate with the Sekhmet's Vigor.
Sentry Hack is a hero skill in Call of Duty: Heroes for Menendez. When activated, he will hack into a Sentry Gun and use it to attack nearby major defenses.
Scorchers are an 800 scorestreak in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, and a hero skill in Call of Duty: Heroes. The Scorchers consist of three Skelter fighter jets that attack the battlefield.

Lieutenant Serozh Sarkisyan is a character who appears in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. He is assigned to the SetDef carrier SDS Hellas. Sarkisyan is killed by Nick Reyes in a dogfight during Operation D-Con.

Secondary Expert is a Loadout Option in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It allows an additional attachment on a player's secondary weapon and can be equipped up to two times, allowing a maximum of four attachments and an optic. This option does not need to be selected separately from any additional attachments, but adding a third or fourth attachment costs 2 Allocation Points each. Each Secondary Expert slot is unlocked separately, with slots being unlocked at Level 24 and 34.

Sensor is a Rare gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, found upon Rare weapon variants. It highlights enemies that have been damaged by the weapon on the minimap. It functions identically to the Recon Pro perk from Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3.
The is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered and Call of Duty: Vanguard.

Serrated is a Basic Training featured in Call of Duty: WWII. Serrated allows the player to take a melee weapon as primary weapon, and grants the player a faster melee (also affects Cavalry Division Division's shield). As a bonus, it automatically gives the player two Throwing Knifes and two Tactical Grenades of the player's choice. The player may also stack Serrated with the Expeditionary Division to be able to carry 3 Throwing Knives.

Schildblitz ("Shield Blitz") is a Blitz featured in Call of Duty: WWII Nazi Zombies, requiring 2,000 Jolts. With this Blitz, the player releases a burst of electricity around them when they reload, dealing damage and stunning Zombies around them, similar to Electric Cherry and Blue Bolts from past titles. As with past similar iterations of this Blitz, the damage of the electric burst is based on a percentage of the amount of ammo used in the magazine.
The Schwerer Gustav is a German 80-cm railway gun seen in Call of Duty: WWII. It is in the middle of the "Gustav Cannon" map, being what the map's name is based on.
The Secret Santa is a melee weapon that was added to Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 with the Operation Absolute Zero update.
The Series 6 Outrider is a melee weapon that was added to Call of Duty: Black Ops 4.
The is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare.
Secondary Operator Mod is a Wildcard featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4. It allows the player to equip an Operator Mod for their Secondary Weapon.
The is a vehicle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War in the Fireteam and Outbreak modes. It was added during the Season Two update.
The is a Muzzle attachment available exclusively for the STG44 assault rifle in Call of Duty: Vanguard. It provides a small reduction to recoil.

The Scorcher is a wonder weapon featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III Zombies. When fired, it shoots a blast of energy that will slowly melt both normal and special enemies, if not killed instantly. The weapon may also be charged to release an even more powerful shot that consumes up to 5 rounds. It also has the capability to launch the player into the air, allowing them to gain distance away from enemies. When upgraded via the Pack-a-Punch Machine or with Aetherium Crystals, it becomes the NAS Boot gaining increased damage and magazine size.
The is an armoured car featured in Call of Duty: WWII and Call of Duty: Vanguard.

Selector Switch is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is exclusive to the "Recruit" Prototype Weapon version of the NV4. It allows the weapon to be swapped between the standard automatic fire mode to a semi-automatic fire mode, whilst also providing a VMC optic.
Second Line, abbreviated as SL, is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.

The Saw Blade Trap is a utility featured in the Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 Zombies maps, Ashes of the Damned, Vandorn Farm, Exit 115, and Ashwood. It is a trap that when purchased for Essence, will play music to attract zombies and kill them when they get in the proximity of its saw.
The is a medium tank that appears in Call of Duty 3 and Call of Duty: WWII and was used during World War II.

The Vz.61 Skorpion is a weapon appearing as a Submachine Gun in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare: Mobilized, Call of Duty: Black Ops, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance, Call of Duty Online and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered, as a Machine Pistol in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, and as a Handgun in Call of Duty: Black Ops: Declassified. It can also be used in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, but only through console commands.

with a Sniper Scope.]] A Sight or Scope is the term generally applied to the aiming mechanism on a gun, whether it be an iron sight or a type of sight that projects a red dot. The default sights on many guns are plain iron sights, but there are guns (such as the AUG HBAR) which have a different sights such as a telescopic sight as the default sight.
Private Sheridan was a soldier who was part of the 1st Infantry Division that fought under the command of Lt. Walker in Call of Duty: Finest Hour.
Siberia Camouflage is a type of Weapon Camouflage in Call of Duty: Black Ops and Call of Duty: Black Ops II.

The Shiv, also known as Prison Knife, is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops, Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II. It is a piece of metal with a tape around one end.
The is a melee weapon that appears in Call of Duty: Black Ops, Call of Duty: Black Ops III, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Mobile.

The Shovel appears as a melee weapon in Call of Duty: Zombies, Call of Duty: WWII, Call of Duty: Mobile and Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, as a utility in Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, Call of Duty: Black Ops III, Call of Duty: Vanguard, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6, and as an equipment in Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0.

The Slava-class cruiser, is a Russian conventionally-powered cruiser used by the Russian Navy. It is featured in the Call of Duty titles, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 and Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War.
Siberian Camouflage was a Weapon Camouflage skin planned to appear in Call of Duty: World at War, but was cut from the game in the final version.
The is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Strike Team, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Mobile and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.

are a unique enemy and animal encountered in the Call of Duty: Ghosts level Into the Deep, the Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare Exo Zombies map Carrier, and as an operator skin in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.
Skulls Personalization Pack is a downloadable content package available for Call of Duty: Ghosts. It contains a weapon camo, reticle, a player background and a player patch.

Shock Plant is a weapon attachment for the Heavy Shield in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. The range and effects of the Shock is similar to the shockwave produced when Boost slamming with Overcharged.

The Sheiva is a bullpup semi-automatic assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops III. It has the lowest rate of fire in its category, but is capable of killing most enemies in two shots, unless one of the shots is a penetration shot.
The Ship-Fired Missile Strike is a scorestreak in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare exclusive to the map Quarantine.

The Skull Splitter (referred to as Mace in the game files) is a melee weapon introduced in Call of Duty: Black Ops III. It is only obtainable through Supply Drops as a Legendary drop. It can be acquired in Revelations by completing 10 rounds in under 13 minutes.

The Slash N' Burn (referred to as Fire Axe in the game files) is a Legendary melee weapon introduced in Call of Duty: Black Ops III as part of the May 6, 2016 update. It is a two handed axe that kills players and bots in one hit.
Skelters are a class of fighter jet capable of combat in air and in space in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare.

Slicer is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is exclusive to the Mauler's Epic Sentinel variant. Whenever the weapon is fired, it will shoot a vertical column of five bullets instead of a single bullet. However, this configuration of the Mauler now has a slower fire rate than its normal counterpart.
The Shamrock Blade is an Epic melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered. It was added via update on March 14th, 2017.

The is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: WWII, Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, Call of Duty: Vanguard, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III, and Call of Duty: Mobile, and making brief appearances in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4.
Silver Bullets are a feature introduced in the Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 Zombies map Dead of the Night. It can be added to any projectile weapon, and increases the damage by 2x.

The Slay Bell is a melee weapon that was added to Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 with the Operation Absolute Zero update. It is a golden handheld bell wrapped in barbed wire and red and green Christmas lights.
The Shadow Blade is a specialist weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 and Call of Duty: Mobile.
The Shield Turret is a Killstreak featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, a Scorestreak in Call of Duty: Mobile and a buildable in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.

Shoot the Ship is a Game Mode featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, and Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile. The mode acts similar to modes such as Rustment 24/7 and features only the maps Shoot House and Shipment.
The Singuard Arms 16.6" SOCOM is a barrel attachment featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare. It is uniquely available to the Kilo 141 assault rifle.
The Singuard Arms 19.8" Prowler is a barrel attachment featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare. It is uniquely available to the Kilo 141 assault rifle.
The Singuard Arms Whisper is a barrel attachment featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare. It is uniquely available to the Kilo 141 assault rifle.

Singuard Arms, usually abbreviated as SA, is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Mobile, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare IIIand Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. Their logo is a stylized SA in block letters.

Silverfield Ordnance, sometimes abbreviated as SO, is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. Silverfield Ordnance appears to have two separate logos: one is a capital S protruding through the top of a circle, the other is a capital SF within an oval. Unfortunately, most all of Lockwood's attachments (and multiple other attachments from other manufacturers) also place the Silverfield Ordnance "S" in a circle logo on their attachments, confusing matters.

The Shock RC is a Scorestreak featured in Call of Duty: Mobile. It was added as part of the Season 5 Steel Legion update. The Shock RC is an unmanned RC vehicle that does a small amount of damage to an enemy and temporarily immobilizes them. After a short duration, the RC will explode and the enemy will be able to move again. A stunned player can tap fire keys multiple times to break free. Shock RCs may shock multiple players at once, but it only requires one player to break free to free the other people trapped.
The Silver Bullet Dispenser is a buildable featured in the Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 Zombies map Dead of the Night. It is used to craft and obtain Silver Bullets.

The Skål Crusher is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard. It was added as part of the Season Three update. The player can use the Skål Crusher as any normal melee weapon via swinging as well as being able to throw it at enemies.

The Signature Attachment is a weapon mechanic featured in Call of Duty: Mobile. The difference with these compared to other attachments is that they cannot be unlocked through leveling up weapons, but through challenges. Once unlocked, each attachment can be only equipped to a specific weapon.

Silent Fury is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is exclusive to the "Hades" Prototype Weapon version of the VPR. It provides the weapon with an integrated suppressor and the ability to gain an increased rate of fire and reduced recoil for a short time after killing an enemy.
The Sky Carrier was a massive warship utilized by the Atlas Corporation, featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and it's Battle Pass comics.
The is a special weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It was added on November 21st, 2024 and released publicly on December 4th, 2024 as part of the Season One update.
The is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It was added on February 27th, 2025 as part of the Season Two Reloaded update.

Shield Expansion is a Wildcard featured in Call of Duty: Mobile. It was added in March 2025 as part of the Season 3: Cyber Mirage update. It is only available in the Battle Royale mode and is a Legendary Wildcard.
The Shadow SK is a sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.
The Shock Shield Stock is a stock attachment featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.
Slide Flak Jacket is a Weapon Perk featured in Call of Duty: Mobile, available to all shotguns and to the Shorty.
The is a bolt-action sniper rifle used by American soldiers throughout most of the World War II-era Call of Duty games.

Private Snyder is a medic with the 29th Infantry Division who tends to Sergeant Dixon's wounds after being hit by machine gun fire at The Crossroads. He carries an M1 Garand. He is one of two Medics in Call of Duty 3, but he doesn't have the markings of a Medic.

The is a controllable vehicle in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 and Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War. It makes an appearance in Call of Duty: Black Ops II multiplayer map Downhill, in Call of Duty: Ghosts multiplayer map Whiteout and in Call of Duty: Mobile Comics.

The is a British single-seat fighter aircraft used by the Royal Air Force and other Allies during World War II. Widely regarded as one of the finest fighters during the war, it can be seen in Call of Duty: United Offensive, Call of Duty 2, Call of Duty 2: Big Red One, Call of Duty: Roads to Victory, Call of Duty: World at War (Nintendo DS) and occasionally in Call of Duty: WWII dogfighting with various Luftwaffe aircraft.
Speed is a Weapon Proficiency in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3.
Snow is a weapon camouflage in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 and Call of Duty: Ghosts.

Snake is a desert weapon camouflage skin in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3. The camo is available for every primary weapon and appears to be based on the naturally occurring camouflages of certain desert snakes. It could also be based on a German desert camouflage.

The Spring Knife is a Special weapon available in the campaign mode of Call of Duty: Black Ops II. It reuses the model of the Ballistic Knife from Call of Duty: Black Ops. It is unlocked by completing five challenges in the campaign mission "Fallen Angel".
The Soviet Prototype Tank is a tank featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops II. It is unlike many other tanks used by the Soviets in the War in Afghanistan due to its extreme size.

The Slug Rounds are a weapon attachment available to shotguns in Call of Duty: Ghosts, Call of Duty: Mobile, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III, Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 and to the Rack-9 Smoothbore variant in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It also appears as a cut attachment in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4. They replace the default buckshot ammunition with slugs similar to that of the KSG from Call of Duty: Black Ops II.
Sovereign is a multiplayer map featured in Call of Duty: Ghosts. It takes place in a tank factory outside of Rio de Janeiro.

The Smart Choke (Integrated Choke in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare) is a weapon attachment that appears in Call of Duty: Ghosts and Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, exclusive to the Tac 12 in Ghosts and the Rack-9 in Infinite Warfare. It is integral to the Tac 12 and Rack-9 shotguns. It decreases the pellet spread when aiming down sights, allowing for more precise damage when aiming down sights.
Space Cats Personalization Pack is a downloadable content package available for Call of Duty: Ghosts. It contains a weapon camo, reticle, a player background and a player patch.
are a mounted anti-air weapon featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 and Call of Duty: Ghosts.

The Sniper is a Unit that appears in Call of Duty: Heroes and Call of Duty: Siege. It appears wearing a Ghillie suit and wielding an L115 bolt action sniper rifle. They have the longest attack range of any Human unit, and they target resource structures first, making them effective at earning loot in PvP attacks against bases that have layouts where resource structures line all around the outer perimeter. In Challenge mode, the Sniper is very effective in some missions where there are no resource structures, so they can deal huge damage from a distance.
The Spiker is a zombie featured in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, on the Exo Zombies maps Infection, Carrier, and Descent.

The Spike Launcher is a weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops III available in the campaign levels Rise & Fall and Life. The Spike Launcher launches explosive spikes that can be detonated remotely. The launcher holds five rounds at a time. When multiple spikes are fired, they will all explode simultaneously when the player activates the detonator. Direct impact shots can also kill enemies. The launcher is given to the player when defending the Egyptian Army checkpoint from the Nile River Coalition, and must be used to detonate underground subway tunnels. It is also found during the Player's hallucinations. It can also gib enemies.

The Specialist Draft is a feature of Arena in Call of Duty: Black Ops III. With this feature, each team is limited to a single specialist ability or weapon for the entire team to use, rather than each individual player selecting a different specialist.

Soap Camouflage is a weapon camouflage skin in Call of Duty: Ghosts, available to the player by purchasing the Soap Legend Pack. The camo is mainly blue, with John "Soap" MacTavish's face appearing on it.
The is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. It was also going to appear in the cut installment Call of Duty: Roman Wars.

Spike is a Gun Perk featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is exclusive to the Volk - Goliath. This gun perk allows the weapon to do increased damage, but it turns the weapon's firing mode to semi-automatic.
The Smiley is a wonder weapon in the Zombies mode of Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is a circular saw that was introduced in the map Rave in the Redwoods.
The Spiked Bat is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, Call of Duty Online and Call of Duty: Mobile. It also makes a brief appearance in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4.

Sniper Mod is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is exclusive to the UDM - Stalker variant. It turns the fully-automatic pistol into a semi-automatic compact sniper rifle, which includes a custom sniper scope.
The Smoke Drone appears as an underbarrel attachment integrated to the Atlas light machine gun in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare.

SoloZero, often abbreviated as SZ, is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Mobile, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. Their logo is a white circle/disc with 2 gray chevrons within it.

Sloan Precision, abbreviated as SP is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare. Their logo, which seems to be an equilateral triangle, appears on the SP-R 26" barrel, the default 5 round .300 Win Mag magazine, the 5 round .300 Norma Mag magazine, and the .338 Lapua Mag magazine.

The Snowboard is a vehicle featured on Battle Royale mode in Call of Duty: Mobile. It was added as part of the Season 13 Wint3r War update. It could be obtained at the winter biomes of Isolated. It is not restricted to the snow biomes as it can be ridden on normal biomes too, albeit it is much slower.
The Sloan KR-800 DeadEye is a bolt assembly attachment featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare. It is uniquely available to the SP-R 208 marksman rifle.

Sniper Expert is a weapon mod featured in the Battle Royale mode of Call of Duty: Mobile. Its Legendary version allows semi-automatic sniper rifles and marksman rifles to fire in a full-auto fashion. The player can toggle between this mode and the standard semi-auto mode.

The is an aircraft carrier used and made by the Imperial Japanese Navy. It is featured in the campaign of Call of Duty: Vanguard in the level The Battle of Midway where it is destroyed along with the Kaga by Wade Jackson.

The is a British Empire fighter aircraft used during World War I. It appears in the skies in the Call of Duty: Black Ops II and Call of Duty: Black Ops III Zombies map Origins. Within the map, multiple Camels can be seen dogfighting with German Fokker Dr. Is in the skies above the map. Some Camels can also be seen destroyed in the map. One needs to be shot down to obtain a piece of the Staff of Fire.

Snowflake is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is exclusive to the "Eliminator" Prototype Weapon version of the Raijin-EMX. It exchanges the Tactical EMP Launcher for a projectile that slows movement speed of enemies that are caught within the explosion radius. It also regenerates grenades for this launcher.

Spool Up is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is exclusive to the "Barrage" Prototype Weapon version of the G-Rail. It allows the weapon to increase in fire rate the longer the weapon is firing, at the cost of a reduced accuracy.

Specialist Stack is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is exclusive to the "Horizon" Prototype Weapon version of the X-Eon. It provides a new gun perk or standard perk every 2 kills. Earning in order Haste, Ninja, Takedown (Enemies death locations are suppressed), Engineer, Deathbringer and Nuclear.
The Sokol 545 is a light machine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7. It was added on December 16th, 2025 as part of the Season One update.
Speed Up Kill is a Weapon Perk featured in Call of Duty: Mobile, available to all shotguns and to the Shorty.

The is a British submachine gun featured in Call of Duty, Call of Duty: United Offensive, Call of Duty: Finest Hour, Call of Duty 2, Call of Duty 3, Call of Duty: World at War (DS), Call of Duty: World at War: Final Fronts, Call of Duty: Black Ops, Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, Call of Duty: Black Ops III, Call of Duty: WWII, Call of Duty: Vanguard and Call of Duty: Mobile . It was cut from Call of Duty: World at War.

Major Stan Jachowicz, also known as Papa Jack, is a Polish tank commander featured in Call of Duty 3. He is a veteran of World War I. He leads the tank crew of Cpl. Bohater, Pte. Marek "Beksa" Ulan, Sgt. Łukasz "Bang Boom" Kolwalski, and Cpl. Joakim "Lucky Rudd" Rudinski in a Sherman Firefly battle group from the Polish 1st Armoured Division.

.]] :Not to be confused with Sticky Grenade. The is a type of explosive used in Call of Duty 2. "Sticky Bomb" is a term used for an field-expedient anti-tank mine made by filling a sock with some form of explosive, attaching a fuse, then sealing the sock and covering it with axle grease to make it "sticky". They were usually attached to the tank's tracks to disable its movement.
The is an American light tank, used in World War II. It was used by both the American and Commonwealth militaries.

Station is a medium-sized multiplayer map available in the first Call of Duty: World at War map pack released in February 2009. It is set in a train station in Berlin with the opposing sides being the Red Army and the Wehrmacht.

The Stryker is an eight-wheeled, all-wheel-drive, infantry fighting vehicle (IFV)/armored personnel carrier (APC). It appears in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare (Nintendo DS), Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 and Call of Duty: Mobile.
The is a light machine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops, Call of Duty: Black Ops Declassified and Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War.
Stolen Wings is the thirteenth mission of Call of Duty: Black Ops (Nintendo DS), where the player commands a stolen Experimental Fighter Jet. The player must fight to allied airspace.
Stability appears as a Weapon Proficiency in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 and as a Common Gun Perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare.
The Storm PSR (Piercing Shot Rifle), referred to as Metal Storm in the game files, is a Sniper Rifle (classified under Special) that appears in Call of Duty: Black Ops II and Call of Duty: Heroes.
The Steel Dragon is an EDI energy heavy weapon in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare.

Steady is a Common Gun Perk that appears in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, found upon certain weapon variants. It reduces hipfire spread for the weapon variant it is applied to. This effect also stacks with the hipfire spread reducing effect of the Laser Sight attachment. The Kendall 44 Cartel variant once had this gun perk, but was updated in the February 3rd, 2017 patch to remove Steady and replace it with Stability. As a result, the Kendall 44 Advantage variant was given this perk in exchange for Stability.

Stacked is a Rare gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, found exclusively to burst fire Rare weapon variants. It reduces the delay between burst fires, whilst simultaneously increasing the recoil, allowing those weapons to perform better at close-quarter engagements, but reducing effectiveness at long ranges.
The Stinger Weapon Kit is an Epic weapon kit available in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered.
The Sterling is a submachine gun that was added in Call of Duty: WWII with the Blitzkrieg event on April 17th, 2018.
The Strelok is an Operator Mod exclusive to the Koshka sniper rifle. It increases hip fire accuracy while starting to ADS, along with reducing idle sway significantly.

The Stiletto Knife is an Operator Mod exclusive to the Strife pistol in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4. It attaches a knife to the end of the weapon, making melee strikes lethal, upwards to round five in Zombies mode. It changes the melee strike into a lunging stab. It does not gain any bonus damage from melee weapon upgrades such as the Bowie Knife.

Stabilizer is a weapon attachment featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 and Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War. It reduces the idle sway when aiming with sniper rifles, Switchblade X9 SMG and the Mozu revolver.

The Stake Knife is a melee Wonder Weapon introduced and exclusive to Dead of the Night. Based on a classic element of Vampire stories, the Stake Knife is a literal wooden stake the player can craft that is particularly effective against Nosferatu's.
The [http://modernfirearms.net/en/submachine-guns/u-s-a-submachine-guns/lwrci-smg-45-2/ Striker 45] is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Mobile.

The Squad Transport, also known as the CD12 Transport, is a ground vehicle featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard and Call of Duty: Warzone. The Squad Transport can carry up to four players. It has a slow acceleration, however after a few moments, it will be at the fastest it can be, being one of the more reliable vehicles to use.

Stickers, also known as Weapon Stickers are a player customization option for the Playercard that appears within the Call of Duty. They can be equipped onto the player's weapon and can be unlocked via the Battle Pass, store, and by completing challenges or prestige in the games.

The Stealth Plate Carrier is an equipment featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0 added with the Season Three update. It could originally be found with the DMZ mode. In Warzone 2.0, it was added to Battle Royale, Resurgence and Plunder with the Season Four Reloaded update. That update added a two-plate version of the Stealth Plate Carrier to both games. When equipped, the vest allows the player to stay off radar and under low profile with the effects of the Ghost perk.
The [http://modernfirearms.net/en/submachine-guns/u-s-a-submachine-guns/lwrci-smg-45-2/ Striker 9] is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.
The is a German assault gun later upgraded to a tank destroyer featured in Call of Duty: WWII and Call of Duty: Vanguard.
The is a self-propelled gun that appears in Call of Duty: WWII where it can be seen as a prop on the map Dunkirk.
The is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III and Call of Duty: Mobile.
Staff Sergeant Suarez is a minor character featured in Call of Duty: Ghosts.

The Strelok Laser is an attachment in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is categorised under the Laser category. It gives the weapon much tighter accuracy when swapping from hipfire to aiming, whilst giving a visible laser when aiming.
Stealth Kill is a Weapon Perk featured in Call of Duty: Mobile, available to the Outlaw sniper rifle and all light machine guns minus the Hades, Bruen MK9 and RAAL MG.

The Steady-LW Stock is a stock attachment featured in Call of Duty: Mobile, where it is exclusively available to the Type 19 assault rifle. It serves a similar role to the Call of Duty: Cold War Raider Stock or KGB Pad, though with slightly lower numerical benefits and downsides.
The Sturmwolf 45 is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7. It was added on January 8th, 2026 as part of the Season One Reloaded update.
Street Fighter is an event and collaboration featured in Call of Duty: Mobile available between December 11th, 2025 and February 8th, 2026. It is themed around the Street Fighter franchise.
The Strider 300 is a sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7. It was added on April 6th, 2026 as part of the Season Three update.
Squad Gun Game is a limited-time game mode featured in Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0. It was added on June 25th, 2026 as part of the Season Four Reloaded update of Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.

The was a medium tank used by the Soviets during World War II. The first model was equipped with a 76.2mm gun, while later modifications improved the turret and were equipped with an 85mm gun. It appears in every Call of Duty game set during World War II where the Red Army is presented, and Call of Duty: Black Ops III.

The is a Soviet main battle tank featured in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, Call of Duty: Black Ops 6, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.
"Tankers" is Chapter 2 and the third mission in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One. It is the one of two tank levels in the game.

The , referred to as Tavor within game files, is a bullpup assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III and Call of Duty: Mobile. It was cut from Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 and Call of Duty: Black Ops II.
